_contract: The CONFIRMATION-RUNG instance of the existing D1 behavioural PHASE grant. It adds no money and no scope: the phase grant already covers confirmation conditional on screening mechanically advancing a candidate, and says each rung takes its own one-use authorization derived from it. The issuer requires the grant's `rung` to equal the issuance's, so the phase grant (rung=screening) cannot itself issue a confirmation artifact; this record restates the same phase allowance with rung=confirmation. The candidate is NOT named here -- it is read and recomputed from the secured screening session evidence at issuance.
_what_the_allowance_means: the SAME cumulative all-in phase allowance the source grant states, not a second one. Every subrun of both rungs is charged against it; the issuer sums all of them (phase mode reads prior spend across rungs).

does_not_authorize: a session above its own derived hard ceiling or the $30.00 per-session limit
a change to the frozen design, preregistration, arms, seeds, battery, recovery recipe, scoring, SESOI, guardrails, bootstrap or decision rule
